title: appendix-ccp12-hopping.md: Inconsistent modulus between CCP-12 pseudocode and fallback table
description: Line 163 specifies 1 + (Hash MOD N) where N = MAX(NChannels, 3), but line 259 in the GNSS fallback table specifies % (N-1). With NChannels=8, line 163 produces channels 1-8 while line 259 produces channels 1-7. The channel ranges are inconsistent between the algorithm description and the fallback chain.
